evidence.quote: Following agency review of the draft permit application, USEPA provided comments in a letter dated March 7, 2018. PPLLC prepared and submitted a response to agency comments on April 2, 2018. Agency approval of the responses was provided in a letter dated April 20, 2018 and request submittal of a final amended permit application. On May 29, 2018, an electronic copy of the Final Amended RCRA Part A and B Permit Application (referred to herein as the final permit application) was submitted to USEPA and followed by the submittal of hard copies that were delivered to the agency on June 7, 2018. After reviewing and processing the final permit application, USEPA issued a letter dated June 22, 2023 requesting the further development of the CMA 3 concept and the preparation of a Corrective Measures Implementation Work Plan. In the letter, USEPA expressed a preference to provide public notification of the proposed selected remedy and the Corrective Measures Implementation Work Plan simultaneously. In follow up emails dated November 8 and 9, 2023, USEPA provided additional details regarding the request for a work plan. This email requested the preparation of an Corrective Measures Implementation Work Plan and provided guidance for the preparation of it. In addition, the email provided additional technical comments on the final permit application. These comments and guidance have been incorporated into this Work Plan. As requested by USEPA, this CMI Work Plan provides a more detailed discussion of CMA 3 by presenting a conceptual design of the approach and identifying current data gaps associated with it. In order to bridge these gaps and develop a final design for the corrective measure, additional data collection activities are necessary as discussed in subsequent sections of this Work Plan. Therefore, this document is intended to serve as a combination conceptual design and pre-design investigation work plan for the implementation of the corrective measures at the Site.
